title: Parallax
description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

items.title: Ukraine and SpaceX address technical limitations and speed restrictions on Starlink satellite internet.
items.content_text: Ukraine and SpaceX have acknowledged technical speed limits on Starlink satellite internet, which have impacted the operational capabilities of Ukrainian drone missions. While both Western and Russian outlets confirm these specific speed thresholds, they differ on the underlying motive. Western media frames the restrictions as a logistical and diplomatic friction point between Ukraine and its allies, whereas Russian media portrays the limitations as a deliberate, politically-motivated sabotage of Ukrainian capabilities by the United States.
